title: Development of a Soft Sensor Using Machine Learning Algorithms for Predicting the Water Quality of an Onsite Wastewater Treatment System.
summary: SVR and Cubist soft sensors use in-line water measurements to estimate offline COD, TSS and E. coli in a field-tested treatment system. Two years of site data (56 points) support COD/TSS estimates; E. coli performance is explicitly poor and transfer to other sites is untested.
